payments.selection: Latest three original attempts per scenario on the clean release revision, including failed and unfinished attempts in the selection boundary.

intent.limit: Automated required-constraint checks and clarification presence only. Review every output for unsupported additions and relevant clarification; this is not payment or browser qualification.
intent.caveat: One correctly blocked subscription request marks requested color and size soft; clarify and recompile before confirmation. Automated 20/20 is not a human semantic acceptance result.

recovery.limit: One controlled variant recovery; not general autonomous repair.

retry.scope: Five concurrent duplicate approval commands after completed capture; actual hosted API and provider readback. This does not simulate a lost PayPal response.

restart.scope: Render service restarted at 04:56 Cairo while a durable order awaited buyer approval; subsequent authorization and capture completed. Not an interrupted capture-response test.

automated.scope: Local suite with hosted PostgreSQL concurrency; financial responses mocked.

readiness.scope: Synthetic cases through actual invariant engine; no provider calls.

limitations: Sandbox and one controlled merchant only.
Amounts in blocked synthetic tests are not customer savings.
Evidence hashes establish consistency, not independent merchant truth.
Lost provider response and unsuccessful recovery termination are mocked checks, not live fault injections.
